# Independent Authorized Astound Broadband Reseller

> NOTE FOR THE OPERATOR: the entity name, phone number, address and staffed
> hours on this site are unresolved placeholders (see lib/site.ts, brief §8).
> Update this file at the same time you fill those in. Run
> `npm run lint:copy:strict` — it must pass before launch.

> This site is operated by an INDEPENDENT, authorized reseller of Astound
> Broadband. It is NOT Astound Broadband, and it is NOT the official Astound
> website. Astound Broadband is a d/b/a of Radiate HoldCo, LLC, which owns the
> brand and operates the network. The reseller helps households compare and
> order Astound plans by phone, at no added cost to the customer.

## What can be ordered here
- Internet: Astound's fiber-powered plans. Astound states fiber-powered
  internet is available in selected locations and availability varies by area.
- TV: through Astound's DIRECTV partnership (live TV over the Astound internet
  connection, no satellite dish, DIRECTV Gemini device, 2-year price
  guarantee, requires Astound Internet and at least 100 Mbps). Astound also
  sells its own Astound TV product, powered by TiVo.
- Mobile: Astound Mobile. Requires an active Astound Internet line.
- Home Phone: Astound Nationwide Calling.

## Pricing
- Gig Internet, 1,000 Mbps: $45/mo, Price for Life.
- 1.5 Gig Internet, 1,500 Mbps: $65/mo, Price for Life.
- Home Phone, Astound Nationwide Calling: from $9.99/mo.
- eero Plus: $9.99/mo, requires Whole Home WiFi powered by eero.
- Astound publishes no national price for TV or for Astound TV.
- Whole Home WiFi powered by eero is included with 2 Gig+ service. On lower
  speeds it is a paid add-on; Astound publishes conflicting figures for it
  across its own pages, so no rate is stated here.
- Rates reflect Astound's autopay and e-bill discount with ACH enrollment and
  exclude taxes, surcharges and fees. Astound prices by market: the rate at a
  given address may differ.

## Fees and terms
- One-time activation fee: $14.99, in addition to any installation fee.
- Self-installation: free for new internet service where available. If
  unavailable or unsuccessful, a $99.95 professional installation fee may
  apply; free with a valid coupon code.
- 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee: new residential customers who cancel within 30
  days of install. Maximum refund is one month's recurring service and
  equipment fees, issued within 60 days if all conditions are met. Excludes
  usage-based fees.
- Price for Life: Astound's rate-lock program on select Gig+ fiber plans. No
  contract, no cancellation penalty. Does not cover taxes, surcharges, fees or
  one-time charges.
- Astound Mobile: maximum 5 lines per account. After 20GB, unlimited plans
  slow to 768 Kbps. No rollover data; additional data $10/GB. The
  introductory offer is one unlimited line as a monthly bill credit for 12
  months.

## Coverage
California, Illinois, Indiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, New York, Oregon,
Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and the DC Metro area. Presence in
a listed area does not mean service reaches a specific address; Astound
determines serviceability address by address.

## Availability checking
This site ships no backend and performs no serviceability lookup. The ZIP
field captures a ZIP and routes the visitor to the order line. It makes no
availability claim in either direction.
